description: This file defines a test grain class for Orleans, implementing IGrainServiceTestGrain, and contains methods that invoke a client service to perform various operations, primarily for testing purposes.

classes.name: GrainServiceTestGrain
classes.description: A test grain class for Orleans that interacts with a grain service client to perform various test operations.

methods.name: GetHelloWorldUsingCustomService
methods.description: Invokes the grain service client to retrieve a 'Hello World' message using a custom service.

methods.name: CallHasStarted
methods.description: Checks if the grain service has started.

methods.name: CallHasStartedInBackground
methods.description: Checks if the grain service has started in the background.

methods.name: CallHasInit
methods.description: Checks if the grain service has been initialized.

methods.name: GetServiceConfigProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration property from the grain service.

methods.name: EchoViaExtension
methods.description: Echoes a string via an extension method in the grain service client.
